title: The hose, running
logline: The hose at Gully's running into the dog's bowl outside the garage door, overfilling it, nobody holding the hose. The bowl-filler's page without the filler. Absent, and the water still comes.

panels.composition: A garden hose lying on gravel running water into an overflowing dog bowl outside a shut garage door, no one holding it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garden hose lying on gravel running water into an overflowing dog bowl outside a shut garage door with no one holding it, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
